paper_title: Shuttle Between the Instructions and the Parameters of Large Language   Models
caption: : The induction performance of SHIP and SFT on SNI with respect to the number of observed samples. The accuracy is the average accuracy over all seen and unseen tasks.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the induction performance of SHIP and vanilla SFT models with respect to the number of observed samples. The x-axis, labeled “observed samples,” displays a linear scale ranging from 1 to 6, with tick labels spaced by one unit. The y-axis, labeled “observed accuracy,” represents a linear scale from 0.7 to 0.8, with tick labels spaced by 0.05. The blue line represents vanilla SFT and begins at a value of approximately 0.72 at observed samples of 1, decreasing to a value of approximately 0.42 at observed samples of 6. The green line represents SHIP and begins at a value of approximately 0.31 at observed samples of 1, holding steady at approximately 0.71 throughout the range of observed samples.
